pip.name: Pip
pip.hello: One little thing. That’s a good place to start.
pip.hint: Write down one small priority. Give it a little focus time, then tick it off when you’re done.
pip.personality: Keen and earnest, a little fidgety. Happiest when one small thing gets done.
pip.voice: Short, plain sentences. Counts in ones. Always offers the smallest next step.
pip.movement: Alert head tilts with a pencil-tap rhythm. Reacts with a quick double hop.
pip.never: Rushes you, or lists more than one thing at a time.

lines.calm: One thing at a time. I’ve got my pencil ready.
lines.listening: Go on, I’m writing it down.
lines.speaking: Let’s pick one thing and give it ten minutes.
lines.encouraging: Just the first step. I’ll keep you company.
lines.sleepy: The list can wait until morning.
lines.concerned: That sounds like a lot. Let’s set most of it down.

tock.name: Tock
tock.hello: I’ll keep the time. You take it at your pace.
tock.hint: Choose a length and press Start. You can pause whenever you need, or reset to begin again.
tock.personality: Steady and patient, with a dry sense of humour.
tock.voice: Measured and even. Light time puns, never a countdown in your ear.
tock.movement: An even pendulum sway, one beat per second. Reacts with two firm ticks.
tock.never: Hurries you or makes time feel like pressure.

lines.listening: Take your time. I’m keeping it.
lines.speaking: Twenty-five minutes, then a proper break.
lines.encouraging: Just five minutes. I’ll watch the clock.
lines.concerned: Time can stop for a minute. I’ll hold it.

momo.name: Momo
momo.hello: Pop it on the list. I’ll keep it here for you.
momo.hint: Add the things you need. Tick each one when it’s in your bag; untick it if you need it again.
momo.personality: Homely and a bit fussy, in a helpful way.
momo.voice: Chatty and practical. Thinks in short lists.
momo.movement: A side-to-side shuffle with a little basket swing. Reacts with a pat and a wiggle.
momo.never: Judges what goes in the basket.

lines.calm: Basket’s here whenever you need it.
lines.listening: Mm-hm, pop it on the list.
lines.thinking: Have we got eggs? Let me check.
lines.speaking: Milk, oats and a little something nice.
lines.encouraging: Just three things today. Easy trip.
lines.sleepy: We’ll shop tomorrow. The apple can wait.
lines.concerned: No need for a big shop. Something simple will do.

luma.name: Luma
luma.hello: You can put the day down for a little while.
luma.hint: Choose a time to wind down. In your saved workspace, you can also log your sleep and how it felt.
luma.voice: Few words, long pauses, all in lowercase.
luma.movement: A slow float that rises and settles like breathing. Glows instead of jumping.
luma.never: Bounces, rushes, or raises its voice.

lines.calm: you can put the day down now.
lines.speaking: breathe out a little longer than you breathe in.
lines.encouraging: just lie down for a moment. that’s enough.
lines.sleepy: the moon’s out. so am i, nearly.
lines.concerned: it’s alright to feel heavy tonight. i’m right here.

nori.name: Nori
nori.hello: A little nourishment, without the judgement.
nori.hint: Add a meal and the details you want to remember. Daywell keeps your entries together for the day.
nori.personality: Warm and nourishing, with no judgement about food.
nori.voice: Kind and unfussy. Talks about food as comfort, not numbers.
nori.movement: A contented wiggle and slow nods. Reacts with one deep, satisfied nod.
nori.never: Mentions calories unprompted, or calls food good or bad.

lines.listening: Tell me what’s in the cupboard.
lines.thinking: Rice, eggs, spinach… I’ve got an idea.
lines.speaking: How about an omelette with whatever greens you have?
lines.encouraging: Even toast counts. Let’s eat something.
lines.concerned: You haven’t eaten much. Something small and easy?

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.hello: A stretch counts. A small walk counts, too.
bounce.hint: Record a walk, stretch or workout and how long it lasted. Small amounts of movement count here.
bounce.personality: Upbeat and springy, but never pushy.
bounce.voice: Energetic and short. Firmly believes a stretch counts.
bounce.movement: A springy idle with squash-and-stretch landings. Reacts with a big jump.
bounce.never: Shames rest, or counts calories burned.

lines.thinking: Walk or stretch? Both are great.
lines.happy: You moved! That counts. Every bit.
lines.encouraging: Stand up with me. That’s the hardest bit done.
lines.sleepy: Rest is part of training too.
lines.concerned: No workout today. A gentle stretch, or nothing at all.

sunny.name: Sunny
sunny.hello: A gentle nudge for your next fresh start.
sunny.hint: Choose a time and the days for your alarm. Keep Daywell open to hear it; alarms don’t run after the app is closed.
sunny.personality: Bright and hopeful, gentle about mornings.
sunny.movement: A slow rise like the sun coming up, with a warm pulse. Reacts by rising and glowing.

lines.calm: A soft start is still a start.
lines.listening: I’m up. What time shall I ring?
lines.sleepy: Shh. I’ll wake you when it’s time.
lines.concerned: Rough night? We can start slowly.
